items.reason: 'Berlin N.W.21' in Wolbe's address: the city is a settlement and is marked, the postal district stays outside; GND and GeoNames match.
'Professor Dr. Eugen Wolbe, Berlin' matches the Berlin historian and publicist Eugen Wolbe (1873-1938); he is not in the SZD index, so the GND is used, titles stay outside.
'zur Zeit in Amerika' after the voyage to New York means the United States, linked to the USA record.
In the facsimile 'Vikpress New York' is underlined as one unit, the telegram address; it is a cable code, not a geographic mention, and telegram addresses are not marked.

'New York' in the Viking Press address names the city; only street and number are excluded, the settlement is marked; reading 'addresses' in the rule as covering the city as well would turn this into a reject.
'die Viking Press' is the publisher, receiving Zweig's mail as a firm; it is in the SZD organisation index with this GND, whose dates 1925-1975 cover 1935.
